findings.recommendation: Check how the mailer maps a timeout once the message data has been handed to the relay (`src/mailer.rs` only says it gives up after `timeout`). If that case returns `Unavailable`, the job is released and sent again, up to 12 times, so a slow relay that does deliver produces duplicate e-mails. Either have the mailer report an ambiguous outcome separately (e.g. dead-letter it or retry with a stable Message-ID the relay deduplicates), or document that duplicates are accepted.
findings.title: A send that times out after the relay accepted it is retried and duplicates the e-mail
